        param = Parameter("theta")
        circuit = QuantumCircuit(1)
        circuit.rx(param, 0)
        
        # Test roundtrip with default settings (should use symengine)
        qpy_buffer = io.BytesIO()
        dump(circuit, qpy_buffer, use_symengine=True)
